an5.165:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe… yo hi koci āvuso paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati sabbo so pañcahi ṭhānehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena
an5.165:1.3: mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati pāpiccho icchāpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati ñātukāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati athavāpanevaṃcitto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati
an5.165:1.4: sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati ahamassa sammadeva byākarissāmīti
an5.165:1.5: yo hi koci āvuso paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati sabbo so imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena
an5.165:1.6: ahaṃ kho panāvuso evaṃcitto paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchāmi
an5.165:1.7: sace me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ no ce me pañhaṃ puṭṭho sammadeva byākarissati ahamassa sammadeva byākarissāmīti.
